provenance.title: SpaceX Inspiration4 Blood Serum Metabolic Panel and Immune/Cardiac Cytokine Arrays (Comprehensive Metabolic Panel and Multiplex)
provenance.licenseVerification: Verified against the official OSDR OSD-575 Version 3 study page, which lists License: CC0-1.0. The direct HTML response did not expose the page content to the local fetcher.
provenance.transformDescription: Parsed the NASA OSDR transformed CSV into sample records and analyte result objects; source NA/N/A/blank tokens become null. No interpolation, normalization, unit conversion, or diagnostic classification is performed.
provenance.unitsAndNormalization: Values retain the physical units encoded in the source headers. The CMP protocol describes Quest Diagnostics laboratory results; this transformed CMP file does not specify a log or cross-sample normalization. The file is transformed to a reusable table schema.
limitations: Study IDs C001–C004 are shown as source pseudonyms and are not linked to Arogya demo astronauts or re-identified.
This is archived serum laboratory research data, not live telemetry, a medical device reading, or a diagnosis.

The study overview description lists L-92, L-44, L-3, R+1, R+45, and R+82; the official study sample table and CMP file also include R+194 samples. All source timepoint labels are preserved as supplied.
No exact collection dates or daily observations are inferred from relative timepoints.
Per-result ranges are displayed only as source-reported laboratory intervals and are not used to assign flags.
